hard.label: Hammer hardness
hard.hover: How hard the hammer tip is: harder is brighter with more bell and tick. Range 0.3 to 3.

vsens.label: Strike sensitivity
vsens.hover: How much the strike speed counts: higher turns a modest hit into a hard one. Range 0.5 to 4.

dyn.label: Dynamic range
dyn.hover: How much louder a hard strike is than a soft one: 0 flat, 1 the full range. Range 0 to 1.

decay.label: Decay
decay.hover: How long the tine rings, measured on middle C. Range 0.2 to 30 s.

dkey.label: Decay by register
dkey.hover: How much shorter the high notes ring than the low ones. Range 0 to 1.5.

prompt.label: Prompt decay
prompt.hover: How much the note drops in its first moment before the long sustain: 0 none, 1 a strong initial fall. Range 0 to 1.

bell.label: Bell
bell.hover: The level of the tine's bell-like second mode. Range 0 to 2.

bratio.label: Bell pitch
bratio.hover: Where the bell mode sits, as a multiple of the fundamental. Range 2 to 16.

bdecay.label: Bell decay
bdecay.hover: How long the bell mode rings, measured on middle C. Range 0.05 to 5 s.

tick.label: Tick
tick.hover: The level of the short attack tick. Range 0 to 1.5.

tratio.label: Tick pitch
tratio.hover: Where the tick sits, as a multiple of the fundamental. Range 6 to 30.

beat.label: Tonebar beat
beat.hover: The level of the tonebar's partner mode, which blooms and wavers against the tine. Range 0 to 0.5.

bcents.label: Tonebar detune
bcents.hover: How far the tonebar partner is detuned: the speed of the bloom. Range 0 to 25 cents.

align.label: Pickup alignment
align.hover: Where the tine sits over the pickup: about 0.58 is sweet, above 0.8 barks, below 0.5 sounds hollow. Range 0.3 to 1.6.

tilt.label: Alignment by timbre
tilt.hover: How far timbre moves the tine over the pickup. Range 0 to 0.6.

drive.label: Pickup drive
drive.hover: How far the tine swings into the pickup: more bark at the same strike. Range 0.2 to 4.

dig.label: Dig
dig.hover: How much pressing into a held key drives the pickup harder. Range 0 to 1.

wurli.label: Pickup type
wurli.hover: The pickup's character: 0 a magnetic Rhodes, 1 an electrostatic Wurlitzer. Range 0 to 1.

damper.label: Damper
damper.hover: How firmly the damper stops the note on release: 0 no dampers. Range 0 to 3.

gain.label: Level
gain.hover: The overall loudness of the sound. Range 0 to 8.

grit.label: Amp grit
grit.hover: How hard the amp is driven. Range 0 to 1.

tone.label: Amp tone
tone.hover: The amp and speaker's brightness: the frequency above which they roll off. Range 800 to 16000 Hz.

bodyhz.label: Body EQ frequency
bodyhz.hover: Where the body EQ band sits. Range 60 to 4000 Hz.

body.label: Body EQ
body.hover: How much the body EQ band is cut (below 0) or boosted. Range -0.9 to 2.

wobble.label: Wobble
wobble.hover: A tape-like wow and flutter of the pitch. Range 0 to 40 cents.

life.label: Life
life.hover: Micro-randomness: 0 every note identical, 1 each one slightly different. Range 0 to 1.
